description: Click an element. If it looks like it buys, pays, sends, posts or deletes, the user is asked to allow it on the page first and the call waits (up to two minutes); if they decline, the call fails and you should not retry.

ref.description: Element ref from the latest snapshot, e.g. "e14".

tab.description: Tab handle from list_tabs, e.g. "chrome:812". Optional when only one tab is shared.

name: click
title: Click an element
